ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows two identical rectangular prism bricks joined face to face, forming three different side-by-side combination methods; beside the three combinations are respectively labeled surface areas 96, 72, 102. The three joining methods correspond to hiding three different types of faces of the original brick. Reasoning: Let the areas of the three different faces of one brick be x, y, z respectively, then the surface area of the original brick is 2(x+y+z). When the two bricks are not touching, the total surface area is 4(x+y+z). If joined along the face with area x, then the two contact faces are hidden, and the total surface area is 4(x+y+z)-2x; similarly, the other two types are 4(x+y+z)-2y and 4(x+y+z)-2z. Add the three given surface areas: 72+96+102=270. On the other hand, adding the three expressions gives 12(x+y+z)-2(x+y+z)=10(x+y+z). Therefore 10(x+y+z)=270, giving x+y+z=27. The surface area of the original brick is 2(x+y+z)=54.

raw_record.question_text: A builder has two identical bricks. She places them side by side in three different ways, as shown. The surface areas of the three shapes obtained are 72, 96 and 102. What is the surface area of the original brick?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it shows two congruent rectangular bricks joined face-to-face in three orientations, labeled with total surface areas 96, 72, and 102. Let the three face areas of one brick be x, y, and z, so the surface area of one brick is 2(x+y+z). When two bricks are joined along a face of area x, the combined surface area is twice the original surface area minus the two hidden copies of that face: 4(x+y+z)-2x. The three pictured joins hide the three different face types, so the three given totals are 4(x+y+z)-2x, 4(x+y+z)-2y, and 4(x+y+z)-2z in some order. Add the three equations: 72+96+102 = 10(x+y+z). Thus x+y+z=27, and the original brick surface area is 2(x+y+z)=54.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the three drawings show a pair of identical rectangular bricks forming three different larger rectangular prisms, each made by doubling the brick in a different dimension, with surface areas 96, 72, and 102. Let the brick dimensions be a, b, and c. The surface area of one brick is S=2(ab+bc+ca). If the pair is made by doubling dimension a, the larger prism has dimensions 2a, b, c, so its surface area is 2(2ab+2ac+bc). Similarly the other two orientations have surface areas 2(ab+2bc+2ac) and 2(2ab+bc+2ca), in some order. Adding the three composite surface areas gives 10(ab+bc+ca). Since the given sum is 96+72+102=270, we get ab+bc+ca=27. Therefore the original brick surface area is 2(ab+bc+ca)=54.

推理：设原来一块砖的长、宽、高分别为 a、b、c，则一块砖的表面积为 S = 2(ab + bc + ca)。两块砖沿某一个维度拼在一起时，得到的大长方体会在该维度上变成原来的 2 倍。例如沿 a 方向拼接，尺寸为 2a、b、c，表面积为 2(2ab + 2ac + bc)。沿 b、c 方向拼接也类似。三个不同拼接方式的表面积相加时，每一种面积乘积 ab、bc、ca 总共出现的系数为 10，所以三者表面积之和为 10(ab + bc + ca)。已知三种表面积为 72、96、102，所以 72 + 96 + 102 = 270 = 10(ab + bc + ca)，因此 ab + bc + ca = 27。原砖表面积 S = 2(ab + bc + ca) = 2 × 27 = 54。
